description: The common part of a task.announced on node_retire: the operator's request that removes a node, vetoes an artifact, lifts its veto or deletes its image (architecture §3.13.8, implementation §10.1). Each kind adds what it names in a schema of its own. The common fields are in data.schema.json.

target_topic.description: The topic of the node or the entry, which routes the request to the Spawner that owns it (architecture §3.13.1).

operator_proof.description: The operator's proof of the act, with act node_retire (architecture §3.14.2, implementation §9.2).
